'''Pokémon: Black & White''', also know  as '''Pokémon: Black & White Song Video''',<ref>TV Schedule | Cartoon Network India ([https://web.archive.org/web/20140803043452/http://www.cartoonnetworkindia.com/tv/schedule/ archived]) {{dead link}}</ref> is a song used as the opening theme for the first {{pmin|Hindi}} [[dub]] of ''[[S14|Pokémon: Black & White]]''. It is made up of clips from the first few episodes of the season. It replaced the Hindi dub of {{so|Black and White}}, {{DL|List of Hindi Pokémon themes|Bada Ya Chota (Cartoon Network dub)|Bada Ya Chota}} (Hindi: बडा या छोटा ''Big or Small''), for rerun television airings on {{wp|Cartoon Network India}}.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
The opening animation uses the following clips in order:
* Many falling boxes hit {{AP|Pikachu}} on the head. <ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* {{Ash}} (without a cap) hugs Pikachu.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash puts on his new {{AP|cap}}.<ref name="BW001" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu uses {{m|Iron Tail}}.<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu uses {{m|Volt Tackle}}.<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* {{TP|Cress|Panpour}} is sent out of a {{i|Poké Ball}}.<ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* {{p|Dewott}} hits Pikachu with {{m|Razor Shell}}. <ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu jumps on Ash's shoulder and both cheerful look at the Poké Ball of Ash's [[Ash's Pidove|latest capture]].<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu and {{TP|Iris|Axew}} eat apples, while [[Team Rocket's arsenal|robotic arms]] appear behind them. <ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash holds Pikachu in the air and spins.<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash throws a Poké Ball for capturing a Pokémon.<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu uses {{m|Quick Attack}}.<ref name="BW001" group="lower-alpha"/>
* {{TP|Ash|Oshawott}} prepares to use an attack.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Oshawott eats Pokémon food.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu climbs on Ash's shoulder.<ref name="BW001" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Oshawott uses {{m|Water Gun}}.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash holds a dirty {{AP|Tepig}} in his arms, while Tepig (with some rope tied around its snout) tries to get free.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Tepig prepares to use an attack.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash and Pikachu stare at a storm in the sky.<ref name="BW001" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Tepig charges towards an opponent.<ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Tepig runs around on a battle field.<ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash, Pikachu and Oshawott celebrate Ash's [[Ash's Tepig|latest capture]].<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Oshawott comes out of its Poké Ball onto the battlefield. <ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash looks on as the door to the [[Striaton Gym]] battlefield opens.<ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu uses {{m|Thunderbolt}}.<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Tepig runs towards {{TP|Chili|Pansear}} and gets hit by Dig.<ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu celebrates Ash's [[Ash's Pidove|latest capture]].<ref name="BW002" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Pikachu discharges electricity in [[Professor Juniper]]'s laboratory while Professor Juniper, [[Professor Oak]], and {{Delia}} look worried.<ref name="BW001" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Tepig spins Pansear around while biting onto its tail.<ref name="BW005" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Ash and Pikachu look at the electrical storm in the sky, with Pikachu noticing something at the core of the storm.<ref name="BW001" group="lower-alpha"/>
* Tepig uses {{m|Ember}}.<ref name="BW004" group="lower-alpha"/>
* A group shot of the Pokémon from {{so|Black and White}} is shown, behind the season logo.<ref name="theme" group="lower-alpha">From {{so|Black and White}}</ref>
